digest.component_or_area: LLM prompt caching and plan-review gate
propositions: Prompt cache writes on every plan-review call but is never read across calls because the cache breakpoint sits after pass-specific suffixes rather than at the shared prefix boundary

The marked prefix embeds the full plan text by design to enable within-run reuse, making cross-ticket prefix identity impossible; the mechanism is correct but the breakpoint placement wastes premium-rate write tokens on single-turn passes
Diagnostic gaps prevent observability: warn_if_cache_ineffective only fires when both write==0 and read==0, so the write-every-call-never-read pattern is invisible

Relocating the cache breakpoint to the end of byte-stable shared_plan_prefix enables within-run reads by Pass-2 verifiers and same-ticket re-review reads inside the TTL, avoiding ~5-6k token-equivalents of premium write waste per review
